title: Samadhi
one_line: The sixth and final limb named in the Shandilya Upanishad; Guruji does not treat it separately in this chapter beyond naming it.
points: Samadhi is named as the sixth of the six limbs of yoga in the Shandilya Upanishad verse Guruji quotes.

sutra.sanskrit: Asanam pranasamrodhah pratyaharascha dharanam / Dhyanam samadhiretani shadangani prakirtita.
sutra.translation: Asana, pranayama, pratyahara, dharana, dhyana, and samadhi are known as the six limbs.
